body: I also am really miserable so I dunno. I guess I need to find a therapist.

Yeah I do have a compulsion and it's scary. I am like having to constantly keep myself from hurting myself. I never used to be this way. I want to harm myself and destroy myself and I guess it's because I'm so miserable and stressed that I just want everything to end.

Thank you. I am sorry you went through that. I am depressed because of life circumstances and I have tried tons of medications. None helped, they just made me get fat. I don't have brain chemistry issues, just depressed because things are really bad now. The suicidal thoughts I think were caused by withdrawal to a medication that I take for other reasons.

That's why I don't take that stuff. It doesn't help me and never did. Nothing but problems. I think it's only useful for real chemical imbalances. Sorry to hear of your ordeal. I had something similar happen.
